name: Slaty Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas (timor and wetar)
description: A long-tailed, uniformly slate-gray dove with bare yellow facial skin. Juvenile browner, with white feather edging.

name: Streak-capped Spinetail
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Mostly brown arboreal spinetail with a black-streaked rufous crown and rufous wings and tail. Has a narrow white eyebrow, diffuse pale streaks on face, and slightly downcurved bill.

name: Storm's Stork
rangeDescription: Lowlands of borneo, eastern sumatra, and malay peninsula
description: Small dark stork with a white neck patch and a bright red bill. Also note bright yellow skin around the eyes.

name: Lesser White-fronted Goose
rangeDescription: Breeds arctic eurasia; winters to southern europe, india, and china
description: Generally uncommon medium-sized goose. Dark chocolate brown with a white forehead and bubblegum-pink bill.

name: Northern Carmine Bee-eater
rangeDescription: Savanna and grassland of sub-saharan africa
description: Large and gorgeous bee-eater with a mostly carmine body, and blue-green head and belly. The central tail feathers are elongated.

name: Cinnamon Warbling Finch
rangeDescription: Breeds central argentina; winters north to salta, tucumán, and córdoba
description: Small gray and rufous tanager of open thorn forest and scrubby desert in central and northern Argentina and southern Uruguay. Both sexes from similar Black-and-chestnut and Black-and-rufous Warbling-Finches by the rufous supercilium and malar not contrasting with the throat in Cinnamon Warbling-Finch.

name: Prong-billed Barbet
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Strange brownish-yellow bird with thick silver bill and chunky body. Face and neck warm ochre; flanks silvery-gray.

name: White-eared Jacamar
rangeDescription: Colombia east of the andes to northeastern peru and western amazonian brazil
description: Chunky-looking bird with a small head and a larger bill than other jacamars, recalling a kingfisher. Chestnut-colored overall with a pinkish-red bill.

name: Jamaican Lizard-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Jamaica
description: An impressive long-tailed bird of moist mid-elevation woodlands including secondary growth, where it feeds in the understory by peeking and probing into vegetation in pursuit of insects and lizards. Generally solitary and secretive, but not shy.

name: Bryan's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Range poorly known; discovered on midway island (hawaii), but probably breeds bonin islands (japan)
description: Smallest known shearwater. Tiny, black and white shearwater with rapidly fluttering wingbeats and an entirely white face.

name: Buru Thrush
rangeDescription: Mid-mountain forest of buru (southern moluccas)
description: A distinctive thrush with chocolate-brown upperparts, a dark head with a conspicuous pale eye-ring, a black throat, and a white belly. Also shows rows of clean white spots on wings.

name: Crested Auklet
rangeDescription: Breeds western alaska and eastern siberia; winters southward to japan
description: Dumpy, dark alcid with pale eyes; very small, only slightly larger than a sparrow. Note the thin white “whiskers” trailing backwards from behind each eye.

name: Palawan Sunbird
rangeDescription: Varied lowland habitats in palawan and satellite islands; also cuyo archipelago and cagayan group in sulu sea (all in southwestern philippines)
description: Tiny and active sunbird of forest edges and open woodlands, endemic to Palawan. Male is olive-gray above, with an extensive iridescent blue-black throat, an orange breast patch, and a pale yellow belly.

name: Jackson's Widowbird
rangeDescription: Grassy highlands of kenya and northern tanzania
description: A medium-sized dark widowbird. Breeding males are unmistakable, with a long downcurved tail and rufous shoulders.

name: Black Turnstone
rangeDescription: Breeds coastal alaska; winters southeastern alaska to northwestern mexico
description: Fairly small, stocky shorebird with short, chisel-like bill. Dark charcoal-colored overall with white belly.

name: Knob-billed Duck
rangeDescription: Tropical africa and madagascar; disjunctly india to southern china
description: Large bicolored waterbird. Both sexes are iridescent purplish-green above with a white or buffy breast.

name: Garden Emerald
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern costa rica and panama; coiba and pearl islands
description: Small hummingbird with limited range. Male entirely glittering green with dark forked tail.

name: Tuxtla Quail-Dove
rangeDescription: Southeastern mexico (sierra de los tuxtlas in southeastern veracruz)
description: Very local, poorly known, and elusive dove of humid evergreen forest in foothills and mountains of Sierra de Los Tuxtlas, near Catemaco in southern Veracruz. Feeds mainly on the forest floor, walking quickly away or flushing explosively from close range.

name: Xantus's Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of southern baja california
description: Stocky, medium-sized hummingbird of the southern half of Baja California peninsula. No similar species in its limited range; endemic.

name: Chuck-will's-widow
rangeDescription: Eastern usa; winters southeastern usa to greater antilles and northern south america
description: Large night bird with a remarkably big head. Plumage is variable, ranging from grayish to strikingly rufous, but always intricately patterned.
